In contrast, Pérez-López and colleagues (165) demonstrated an upregulation of skeletal muscle gene expression after a resistance training bout, with an association between its expression and early-stage elevations in post-exercise myofibrillar protein synthesis. Despite the burgeoning research on this myokine, the extent of its hypertrophic role during regimented resistance training remains unclear.
